name: Okta — MFA Factor Reset or Deactivation
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = okta_sso_raw
| filter okta_sso_raw.eventtype in ("user.mfa.factor.deactivate","user.mfa.factor.reset_all","user.mfa.factor.suspend")
| alter user_name = xdm.target.user.upn,
        admin_upn = xdm.source.user.upn,
        outcome   = xdm.event.outcome
| filter outcome = "SUCCESS" and user_name != null
| filter not (admin_upn contains "svc-" or admin_upn contains "api-")
| bin _time span = 15m
| comp count() as mfa_changes,
       values(admin_upn) as reset_by
       by user_name, _time
| filter mfa_changes >= 1
| fields user_name
description: user.mfa.factor.deactivate, user.mfa.factor.reset_all, user.mfa.factor.suspend, or system.mfa.factor.deactivate event — MFA being bypassed or reset to enable account takeover.
alert_name: Okta — MFA Factor Reset or Deactivation

TA0006 - Credential Access: T1556.006 - Modify Authentication Process: Multi-Factor Authentication
